item.title: Eager to unload two orcas, French government learns more about Nova Scotia proposal
item.description: HALIFAX — French government officials met Monday in Paris with a U.S.-based group that wants to move France’s last two captive whales to a proposed coastal refuge in Nova Scotia.

item.title: Vladimir Guerrero Jr. says World Series loss is behind him as Blue Jays open spring training
item.description: DUNEDIN, Fla. (AP) — Vladimir Guerrero Jr. was the last person to leave the Toronto dugout after the Game 7 loss to the Los Angeles Dodgers in the World Series last fall because the star slugger wanted that to be the moment when he moved on.

item.title: Dodgers utility man Tommy Edman won't be ready for opening day coming off ankle surgery
item.description: GLENDALE, Ariz. (AP) — Los Angeles Dodgers utility man Tommy Edman won't be ready for opening day following offseason surgery on his right ankle.

item.title: Oldham wins gold, Sarault claims silver, hockey final set at Milan Cortina Olympics
item.description: MILAN — Megan Oldham delivered Canada’s second gold medal of the Milan-Cortina Olympics on Monday, winning the women’s freestyle skiing big air competition. The 24-year-old from Parry Sound, Ont., finished with a two-run combined score of 180.

item.title: Canada into Olympic women's hockey final, Poulin breaks record in 2-1 win over Swiss
item.description: MILAN — Canada will play for women's Olympic hockey gold again.

item.title: Goalie fisticuffs aside, Cougars lack fight in fifth loss to Penticton Vees
item.description: Sub-par road effort ends Cats' three-game winning streak; next stop: Swift Current

item.title: Twins starter Pablo López ends bullpen session early after experiencing elbow soreness
item.description: FORT MYERS, Fla. (AP) — Minnesota Twins right-hander Pablo López ended a bullpen session early on Monday over what manager Derek Shelton said was “a little bit of elbow soreness.

item.title: 'Dodgy burger' rules Santner out against Canada as New Zealand targets T20 World Cup Super 8s
item.description: CHENNAI, India (AP) — Canada won the toss Tuesday and elected to bat against a New Zealand lineup targeting a spot in the Super 8s at the T20 World Cup.
